subject: english
question:
Select the sentence that has a spelling error.

A. A fisherman, enfeebled with age, could no longer go out to sea so he began fishing in the river.

B. Every morning he would go down to the river and sit there fishing the whole day long.

C. In the evening, he would sell whatever he had caught, buy food for himself and go home.

D. One hot afternoon, while he was bemoaning his fate, a large bird alited near him.

options.text: One hot afternoon, while he was bemoaning his fate, a large bird alited near him.
In the evening, he would sell whatever he had caught, buy food for himself and go home.
A fisherman, enfeebled with age, could no longer go out to sea so he began fishing in the river.
Every morning he would go down to the river and sit there fishing the whole day long.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**alited**' is incorrect in the sentence "One hot afternoon, while he was bemoaning his fate, a large bird **alited **near him."
 
• The **correct** spelling is **'alighted' **which is the past form of 'alight'.
 
• **Alight **means to descend from the air and settle. (हवा से उतरना और बसना)
 
 
• **Example:** A butterfly **alighted** on the flower.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is** "One hot afternoon, while he was bemoaning his fate, a large bird alited__ near him."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Enfeebled** (कमजोर किया हुआ) - Weakened.
 
• **Bemoaning **(विलाप करना) - Expressing grief or disappointment.
